overview: A one-page “List of Papers” for a State Department file concerning the arming, guarding, and convoying of Japanese merchant vessels. It records a telegram from Chile, attributed to Bowers and dated March 27, reporting a Valparaíso rumor that convoyed Japanese merchant ships would soon arrive there; local investigations reportedly found no confirmation. The entry also notes that the telegram quoted a memorandum enclosed with a March 23 letter from the U.S. consul at Valparaíso.

subfiles.about: The index records an unconfirmed rumor that convoyed Japanese merchant vessels would soon arrive at Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists telegram no. 2893 from Chile, attributed to Bowers and dated March 27. It reports a rumor circulating at Valparaíso that several convoyed Japanese merchant vessels would arrive in the near future, but states that investigations produced no confirmation. The telegram quoted a memorandum enclosed with a March 23 letter from the consul at Valparaíso.

interest: This index sheet is useful for tracing diplomatic monitoring of Japanese commercial shipping and local port rumors, even though the underlying telegram and memorandum are not included here. Its explicit statement that officials investigated but could not confirm the report illustrates the caution with which consular intelligence was evaluated. The reference to an earlier consular letter also reveals the chain by which local maritime information reached the State Department.
